# QT Imaging to Ring the Nasdaq Closing Bell on October 2 in Recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month


September 29, 2026 8:30am EDT


NOVATO, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[QT Imaging Holdings, Inc.](http://www.qtimaging.com/) **** (Nasdaq: QTI) (“QT Imaging” or the “Company”) **,** a medical device company dedicated to transforming breast health management through innovative, radiation-free imaging technology, today announced that Chief Executive Officer Dr. Raluca Dinu will ring the Nasdaq Stock Market Closing Bell on October 2, 2026, in recognition of Breast Cancer Awareness Month. She will be joined by QT Imaging’s executive leadership, team members, and key partners.


The ceremony will take place at Nasdaq MarketSite in New York City's Times Square and will highlight the importance of breast health, early detection, and continued innovation in breast imaging.


“Ringing the Nasdaq Closing Bell on the first days of Breast Cancer Awareness Month carries special meaning for QT Imaging. We believe the future of breast healthcare should give women more information without asking them to accept unnecessary discomfort, radiation, or contrast,” said Dr. Dinu. “This moment is about more than our company. It is about the women we serve, the clinicians and researchers advancing the field, and our shared responsibility to continue building better options for breast health. We are proud of how far QT Imaging has come, and even more energized by the work ahead.”


QT Imaging’s technology platform combines its FDA-cleared Breast Acoustic CT™ scanner with the QTI Precision Pathway™, an integrated platform designed to support image management, collaboration, quantitative analysis, and the deployment of advanced software capabilities. The Breast Acoustic CT™ scanner uses low-frequency sound waves to generate true three-dimensional images of breast tissue without ionizing radiation, compression, or contrast administration. Together, the scanner and QTI Precision Pathway™ are designed to create a more patient-centered imaging experience while providing physicians with additional information and tools to support breast health assessment.


**Nasdaq Closing Bell Ceremony**


The ceremony is scheduled for Friday, October 2, 2026, with the closing bell at 4:00 p.m. ET. A live broadcast of the ceremony is expected to begin at approximately 3:45 p.m. ET and can be viewed at:[https://www.nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony](https://www.nasdaq.com/marketsite/bell-ringing-ceremony)


**About QT Imaging**


QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: QTI) is a medical device company engaged in the research, development, and commercialization of innovative imaging systems that use low-frequency sound waves. QT Imaging Holdings, Inc. strives to improve global health outcomes. Its strategy is predicated upon the fact that medical imaging is critical to the detection, diagnosis, and treatment of disease and that it should be safe, affordable, accessible, and centered on the patient’s experience. For more information on QT Imaging Holdings, Inc., please visit the Company’s website at[www.qtimaging.com](http://www.qtimaging.com/) and follow us on[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/qt-imaging-holdings/) .


Breast Acoustic CT™ is a trademark of an affiliate of QT Imaging Holdings, Inc.
